Method of Attack: Compromising websites and injecting plain-text or obfuscated JavaScript to redirect visitors through a chain of free .TK domains leading to tech support scams or fake blogs displaying unclosable popup ads
Automated registration of free .TK domains using victim's Gmail credentials via a malicious Chrome extension
Attack Vector: Injected JavaScript redirects on compromised websites
Malicious Chrome extension using victim's Gmail credentials to register free domains
Indicators of Compromise: Injected plain-text or obfuscated JavaScript in web pages
72 known active .TK domains involved in the scam
